newsitem.title: GERMANY: Rheinmetall H1 sales up 19.6 pct. [CORRECTED 10:20 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Rheinmetall H1 sales up 19.6 pct. [CORRECTED 10:20 GMT]

text.p: German machinery and armaments maker Rheinmetall AG said its sales in the first half of 1997 were up 19.6 percent to 1.84 billion marks (Corrects from 18.4 billion).
The rise was largely due to the acquisition of Hirschmann, without which sales were up 3.4 percent, the company said.
Incoming orders for the half were 17 percent above planned levels at 2.1 billion marks, it said.
Orders on hand at the end of the first half were little changed from last year's level at 3.6 billion marks.
Other acquisitions including STN Atlas Elektronik and Kolbenschmidt should boost this year's sales to just under seven billion marks, and next year to just above seven billion marks.
